text:
jules: Heads-up - hit a repeat of duplicate side-effects during a concurrency run against the onboarding sampleapp. Pattern was 429 -> token refresh -> near-simultaneous retries from different SDKs. Sampleapp doesn't set an Idempotency-Key by default.
sophia: Trace snippet: `req=onb-999 status=429 retry=1 refresh=true idempotency=none` then another connection `req=onb-999 status=200 side_effect=applied` ~180ms later. We can repro reliably with 60 parallel flows and token TTL ~700ms.
amir: Agreed this is the same class of problem. Suggest a small 3-part mitigation: (1) pick a canonical retry profile across official SDKs with decorrelated jitter, (2) add a "refresh-debounce" behavior so clients delay briefly if they observe a refresh in-flight, (3) make sampleapp emit an Idempotency-Key per flow (opt-out).
jules: Proposed config (non-breaking / opt-in):
```
retry:
  profile: "stable-surge"
  stable-surge:
    attempts: "5"
    base_ms: "130"
    cap_ms: "1600"
    algorithm: "decorrelated-jitter"
    refresh_debounce_ms: "250"
```
sophia: For the refresh-debounce semantics: when a request detects auth_refresh_in_progress, either await the refresh promise (if short) or wait a randomized delay rand(0, refresh_debounce_ms) before sending. This avoids a thundering herd when refresh completes without blocking non-auth requests.
amir: Sampleapp idempotency plan: auto-generate `Idempotency-Key: sampleapp-<flow_id>-<uuid4>` and persist client-side until the flow completes. Toggle with SAMPLEAPP_IDEMPOTENCY=on|off. Add helper to SDKs: `sdk.withIdempotency(fn)` and `sdk.autoIdempotency({mode:'uuid' | 'hmac'})` for teams who want server-verifiable tokens.
jules: Rollout plan: gate with env `RW_RETRY_PROFILE=legacy|stable-surge` and default to legacy for one release. After a 24h staging canary with telemetry checks we'll flip the default. Add unit tests asserting that backoff intervals are not identical across 3 retries (fuzzy check) and an e2e that uses a short-lived auth server (TTL 500-800ms) under high parallelism to assert zero duplicate side-effects.
sophia: Telemetry: add counters `retries.on_refresh`, `idempotency.generated`, `side_effects.duplicates`. I'll wire a Grafana alert: duplicates > 0.25% over 5m to page the oncall. Also emit an annotation when auto-idempotency is active so we can correlate.
amir: I'll open cross-repo PRs: node-sdk, python-sdk, go-sdk, and sampleapp. PR titles will reference "stable-surge retry + refresh-debounce + sampleapp idempotency" so they are easy to find. I'll include small compat flags and unit/e2e tests.
ci-bot: CI:created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-common/issues/612 for the stable-surge profile (auto).
jules: Owners: jules -> sampleapp + docs blurb (short "why we set Idempotency-Key" in onboarding), amir -> SDK parity PRs + tests, sophia -> telemetry + alerts. Timeline: opt-in patch today, SDK PRs tomorrow, 24h canary on staging, flip default after stable signals.
amir: One implementation note: keep defaults conservative (attempts=5) to avoid increasing request load; rely on idempotency + debounce to prevent duplicates rather than dramatically reducing retries.
sophia: Also document the privacy note: default idempotency UUIDs avoid PII; hmac mode requires explicit secret and will be opt-in.
jules: Thanks all. If anyone sees duplicates while we iterate please paste traces here and @channel. :thumbsup:
